diagram_math_checks.justification: def-ferrers-young-diagram-conjugate-partition-and-durfee-square defines cells 1<=i<=r, 1<=j<=lambda_i and conjugate parts as counts of rows of length at least j. The drawing uses top-to-bottom rows and left-to-right columns, with zero-based drawing coordinates x=j-1,y=-(i-1). The map (i,j)->(j,i) is the transpose used in lem-partition-conjugation-is-an-involution proof 1.1; the double arrow asserts precisely the listed conjugate pairing.

diagram_math_checks.check: All actual source pairings and eleven partitions
diagram_math_checks.justification: Independently counted columns: (6)->(1,1,1,1,1,1); (5,1)->(2,1,1,1,1); (4,2)->(2,2,1,1); (4,1,1)->(3,1,1,1); (3,3)->(2,2,2); (3,2,1)->(3,2,1). Each sums to 6. These five distinct pairs plus one fixed partition exhaust the eleven partitions in ex-partitions-of-six-listed. A separate local Node computation of all six column-count lists also agreed.

diagram_math_checks.check: Every pictured row, column and cell
